title: Wonderfully Made
story:
A young boy once looked at a handmade painting in a gallery.

He noticed every detail was carefully designed.

The colors.

The patterns.

The fine brush strokes.

He asked the artist,

“Did you really take so much time for this?”

The artist smiled and said,

“Yes, because it is special.”

“Nothing about it is random.”

“It was made with care and purpose.”

The boy stood silently, admiring it.

In life, people often feel ordinary or unimportant.

But God’s creation is never random.

Every person is carefully designed.

Every detail has meaning.

And each life is wonderfully made by Him.
life_lesson: You are wonderfully made by God with care and purpose.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for creating me wonderfully.

Help me to see my value through Your eyes.

Remove every thought that makes me feel less than enough.

Remind me that I am Your beautiful creation.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you sometimes feel ordinary or unimportant?

How does it change you to know God made you wonderfully?

What part of your identity do you need to surrender to Him today?
